Use case: ui-mockup. Original Swedish live voice tutor "Räven", for åk 1–6. Generate a polished flat front-on WEBSITE UI image, not a device photograph. Reference 1 is Johan's composition sketch ONLY: brand top-left, hamburger top-right, centered companion hero, short action below. Do NOT copy the sketch's white page or dark rectangular image mat. Reference 2 supplies the exact original FOX IDENTITY: blue/lavender fur, cream muzzle and chest, amber eyes, navy hoodie, orange neckerchief, NO WINGS. Preserve its friendly recognizable face. Character is an isolated transparent-looking cutout directly on the SAME page background, no image rectangle or square mat. Mouth CLOSED with a friendly expectant smile because no call has started. Two hands visible. Faint dark grid, slate #181B22 canvas, text #F3F5F8, cards #222731, cyan #22D3EE primary action, muted #A3ABBB text. No scenery, room, giant shadows, dashboard chrome, extra navigation, profile grids, grade selectors, call controls, status bars, fake audio waves, gradients, neon, streaks, confetti, children, real names, logos or trademarks. Use readable Lexend-like rounded sans-serif and Swedish å ä ö. Large touch targets and quiet page, generous negative space. Hierarchy: small brand and menu, companion hero, ONE main action area. Not a marketing page. Top-left brand text "Räven", top-right three-line hamburger. Clear 1-line purpose text "Läxhjälp du pratar med". Tiny footer "Ingen inloggning · Integritet i menyn". Before any call, clearly say "Nästa steg: tillåt mikrofonen." under the main start action, but not as scary warning. No automatic mic activation before action. No actual learner data. All text exact and legible.
DIRECTION: Refined version of Johan's sketch: generous centered fox hero above a single name input. Label directly above input EXACT "Ditt namn:". Field is EMPTY, no fictional name pre-filled. Right INSIDE the input is a clear cyan round arrow-right START BUTTON, visually looks clickable and has enough tap size. Under field one concise helper "Börja prata med Räven". Purpose line sits above hero, not a speech bubble. NO speech bubble in this direction. One field and one integrated arrow action only, no separate redundant primary button. Header stays small.
FORMAT: One single complete 16:9 DESKTOP UI SCREEN, 1536x864 or 1920x1080. No collage, no inset, no browser or device frame. Centered hero and action area max width 420px, generous space left and right. Companion about 42% of viewport height, all hands inside frame. Header aligned to 48px outer margin. Hero and form visible together without scrolling.
